messages:
maria: Postmortem summary posted. We need concrete owners and short deadlines for the follow-ups: runbook triage clarity, escalation matrix, and autoscaler tuning. I want clear action items by EOD.

alex.m: I can do autoscaler tuning. Plan: run a param sweep (maxReplicas, targetCPU, queue-based policy) and add a fallback to cheaper model variant when queue_depth > 400. ETA: 2026-04-02. I'll open a draft PR with perf results.

jordan: I'll take the runbook triage updates. Intention is to add a 5-step checklist, exact commands for control-plane + worker checks, and a "what success looks like" field for each step. ETA: 2026-03-29.

sam: dropping the core commands that should go verbatim into the runbook (put these under "node + queue health"):

# control-plane checks
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide
kubectl -n inference describe hpa inference-router
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-router -c router --since=10m | grep -i "backpressure\|throttl"

# worker checks (ssh to a GPU node)
ssh ops@gpu-node-2
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu,memory.used --format=csv
tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/worker.log | grep -i "reconnect\|kvmiss\|queue_depth"

sri: I'll own the escalation matrix doc. I'll specify who to page at 3m/10m/30m based on severity and whether customer impact is detected. Also adding account manager contact flow for enterprise customers. ETA: 2026-04-06.

ops-bot: incident tracker updated: pm#12456 linked to this thread (https://github.com/redwood/pm/pulls/12456)

alex.m: quick note: in staging the autoscaler hit limits when maxReplicas=8. I suggest testing 16 and 32 with staged traffic profile. Also adding a metric alert if model fallback runs > 2 times in 15m.

jordan: good call. I'll add a troubleshooting decision tree item for "cache stampede vs routing hotshard" and exact log lines to grep so on-call can triage in the first 5 minutes.

sam: I'll produce a short snippet explaining expected outputs for the commands above (e.g., HPA desired/current, router backpressure message examples, GPU utilization thresholds). Will attach as a gist and convert to markdown.

maria: owners consolidated here: alex.m (autoscaler tuning, 2026-04-02), jordan (runbook triage edits, 2026-03-29), sri (escalation matrix, 2026-04-06), sam (troubleshooting snippets + commands, 2026-03-30). I will run a 45m sync Friday 15:00 UTC to unblock PRs. Please update status before the sync.

alex.m: ack, creating perf job and PR draft.

jordan: ack, adding "on-call runs these commands within 5 minutes" language at the top of the runbook steps.

sri: adding on-call rotation table and escalation phone/SMS flow. Will include primary/secondary and cloud provider pager info.

sam: gist: https://gist.github.com/sam/incident-commands-2026 will have the exact grep strings, will paste in runbook after review.

maria: recurrence note: this is the third similar incident in 6 months. Proposing a monthly incident-pattern review in the playbook (owner: platform lead) and an automatic tag in the tracker for repeat incidents.

alex.m: propose alert tuning: queue-depth threshold 350 -> 300 and a new alert for "fallback model triggered" so we can correlate cost spikes with fallbacks.

jordan: will add the immediate triage instruction: "if HPA desired > current for 3 consecutive polls, escalate to infra SRE" and include command to scale manually as emergency measure.

maria: after runbook edits merge, we'll run two simulated incidents in staging to validate the steps and measure time-to-detect and time-to-fix. Proposed validation week: 2026-04-12. Volunteers for run-through?

alex.m: I'll run the perf portion during validation.

jordan: I can play on-call and execute the runbook steps.

sri: I'll observe escalation path timing and note handoff issues.

ops-bot: reminder created for runbook validation exercises: 2026-04-13T14:00:00Z

maria: thanks everyone. I'll create the single action-tracker issue linking PRs, docs, and the validation schedule.
